semantics.selected_relation: one declared four-ary predicate; other P0 predicates and unary rules unchanged
semantics.event_identity: fresh per source ledger/assertion; no key uniqueness or tuple deduplication in stored history
semantics.statement: event_tuple with exactly four scalar roles, or unchanged_atom for other predicates
semantics.adoption: P0 envelopes, human reviews, revisions, context and view preserved; active only after positive adoption
semantics.negative: denies the whole tuple; never individual roles
semantics.query: one fresh hidden event variable per source atom; active and four roles share that variable
semantics.projection: return only old query variables; deduplicate answers and merge all source evidence
semantics.unsupported_queries: event_count, event_identity and unknown kinds remain out of scope
semantics.split_roles: known incorrect diagnostic translation; distinct active witnesses per role, never certified
semantics.roundtrip: reconstruct complete source snapshot from statement roles and assertion envelopes
semantics.certificate: finite execution checks only; not_certified even when finite answers match

steps: reify/restore: one per assertion and review, one before committing the complete roundtrip artifact
query target: prepay one per assertion and review for each view; one at each query start and completion
query target: P0 unary closure charges, one per join candidate, one per final internal binding projected
compare: one for history comparison, P0 legacy replay charges, target query charges, one per completed comparable row
split_roles diagnostic: additional shared-event and split-role target evaluations use the same request budget
resource_stop: no partial artifact, query bindings, difference or certificate; completed other queries retained
hashes: native spec raw SHA-256 pinned in handler; snapshots canonical SHA-256; raw source history reconstructed without normalization
